sections.heading: SPECIALIZATION IN WORLD RELIGIONS AND CULTURES
lines: Completion of first-year requirements. Religious Studies 1023E is recommended.
0.5 course normally taken in second year: Religious Studies 2200F/G.
2.5 courses: Religious Studies 2218F/G, Religious Studies 2281F/G, Religious Studies 2283F/G, Religious Studies 2285F/G, Religious Studies 2286F/G.
0.5 course from: Religious Studies 3300F/G, Religious Studies 4400F/G.
2.0 additional courses in Religious Studies at the 2100 level or above, except Religious Studies 2208U, Religious Studies 3308U and Religious Studies 4408Y.

3.5 additional courses from: Philosophy 2660E, Religious Studies 2260F/G, Religious Studies 2261F/G, Religious Studies 2262F/G, Religious Studies 2263F/G, Religious Studies 2284F/G, Religious Studies 2345F/G, Religious Studies 2346F/G, Religious Studies 2347F/G, Religious Studies 2500F/G, Religious Studies 2501F/G, Religious Studies 2502F/G, Religious Studies 2503F/G, Religious Studies 2504F/G, Religious Studies 2289F/G, Religious Studies 3360F/G, Religious Studies 3452F/G; or 0.5 language course* from: Arabic 1030, Chinese 1150, Chinese 1151, Chinese 1152A/B, Chinese 1153A/B, Hebrew 1030, Hebrew 1040A/B, Hebrew 1041A/B.
* If a 1.0 language course is taken, the module will be 9.5 courses.
